analytical_formula: For primitive real odd quadratic chi of conductor d and root number +1: Lprime(1)/L(1)=EulerGamma+log(2*pi)-[sum_{a=1}^{d-1}chi(a)logGamma(a/d)]/L(0,chi), L(0,chi)=-(1/d)sum_{a=1}^{d-1}a chi(a). Uses Hurwitz zeta at zero and functional equation, no RH.
caveats: d=1319 quadratic character Legendre modulo d, fundamental discriminant -d; finite gamma evaluations mpmath, formula analytically exact, high-precision numeric is not a Lean certificate
